title: PhysioFeatures
description: Physiological monitoring output published at ~1 Hz by 02_vehicle_physiological. 'available' is false when physio.enabled=false in config.

available.description: False when physio pathway is disabled or sensor is absent

theta_alpha_ratio.description: EEG theta/alpha power ratio (increases with drowsiness)

hrv_rmssd.description: HRV RMSSD – root mean square of successive RR differences (ms)

physio_score.description: Composite physiological drowsiness score (0=alert, 1=critical); 0 when not available
